Lina M: Running through the new langchain+next sample (examples/langchain-next-eval). Hitting a couple DX issues: auth retries + streaming leak. Anyone else?
Omar V: repro? which SDK version and how you set the key?
Lina M: @Omar using @redwood/inference-js 0.9.4-beta, Next 14.3. I paste ephemeral token into .env.local from the console. On first run, UI posts prompt but never resolves. Server logs show rapid 401 then 502, then retries forever.
Nidhi R: That sounds like the TS client not recognizing a successful ephemeral refresh and continuing retries. Python client has special-case behavior.
Lina M: logs snippet: ```[2026-04-05T08:12:01Z] INFO refresh ephemeral key -> 200
[2026-04-05T08:12:01Z] ERROR RequestError 401
[2026-04-05T08:12:01Z] INFO retrying attempt=2
[2026-04-05T08:12:01Z] ERROR upstream 502
[2026-04-05T08:12:01Z] INFO retrying attempt=3```
Omar V: repro'd locally. Seems racey: refresh returns 200 but some in-flight requests still see 401 and the retry logic treats that as retryable and doesn't bind the refreshed token. Quick fix: after refresh success write token into the client singleton and bump `lastRefresh` timestamp; `shouldRetry` should avoid requeuing 401s if within 1s of lastRefresh.
Nidhi R: filed PR #1562 with tests and a changelog note. CI green on linux/mac.
QA Bot: PR #1562 CI: tests 420/420  flaky windows job queued.
Lina M: second issue: streaming sample uses `fetch()` and doesn't abort on route change; when I navigate quickly during dev it leaves open sockets and Node hits FD limits. Minimal fix is AbortController in the sample.
Omar V: added an issue with repro and suggested patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/issues/421 — includes code snippet using AbortController and useEffect cleanup.
Docs Bot: recommend we add a short "Devgotchas" section to the langchain-next example README: ephemeral key TTL, devcontainer paste step, and the streaming abort pattern.
Nidhi R: agree. We should also add an e2e that runs the sample in CI using the ephemeral-key-mock to surface regressions.
Lina M: will draft README updates and an e2e mock. Happy to pair for the e2e.
Omar V: thanks all — once PR is merged we can flip the example to the patched branch and ship the bootcamp. :shipit:
